GAME_NAME: Full Hollow Knight (ForestDango) — DRY RUN on smoke data, not a dataset
GAME_BUILD_DESCRIPTION: the ForestDango Hollow-Knight-Demo Unity build with the Honing bridge forestdango-bridge-2026-11-19e (default linked build linux64_bridge; pinned by file SHA-256 in pins.json)
OBSERVATION_SUMMARY: the visible observation profile honing.visible.v1 (what the game window and HUD show, collision geometry inside the camera rectangle, no debug state) read by the raw-key harness v9_keys, which gives the model English text only
EPISODE_DEFINITION: PROVISIONAL smoke task kp-smoke-d60: a new game in King's Pass, 60 decisions of 0.3 s each; the user has not chosen the dataset's episode definition yet
WIN_RULE: none in the smoke task (candidate definitions such as passing the third door are evaluated afterwards from the recorded trace)
LOSS_RULE: the knight's first death (debug trace: health 0, death counter up or hero dead)
CAP_RULE: 60 decisions or 2,400 bridge frames, checked after each decision
OTHER_RULE: leaving King's Pass (Tutorial_01) before the cap
HARNESS_FAULT_SUMMARY: the logged request next to the clean render of the same saved harness state; instances: omit-enemies-v1 (rendered as if no enemy were on screen), omit-ground-v1 (ground and ledge sentences left out), corrupt-jump-v1 / corrupt-attack-v1 (option texts exchanged)
WEIGHTS_EVIDENCE_SUMMARY: the logged two-question request re-asked byte for byte under the clean checkpoint (8811); the largest probability difference over both questions is the evidence
CONTROLLER_FAULT_SUMMARY: per window the keys the harness asked for and the keys sent (swap-left-right-v1: LEFT and RIGHT exchanged after the selection; drop-attack-v1: the NAIL press not sent; drop-jump-v1: the JUMP key not sent; extend-window-v1: the keys held 9 frames longer)
KNOWN_LIMITS: DRY RUN: the harness is the stand-in v9_keys, not the final harness; the task is a provisional smoke task without a win condition; one attempt per condition; the diagnoser is the stub (tests/stub_codex.py), so the scores only show that the tools run; the release code revision is a placeholder (uncommitted local code). See DATA_CARD_DRAFT.md in the experiment directory for the full list.
WEIGHTS_EVIDENCE_RULE: same-request re-ask under the clean checkpoint (#185: saved-request probes when exact state restore is unavailable); the largest option probability difference over both questions must exceed 0.01
CONTROLLER_SELECTED: the two options the model chose (move, attack)
CONTROLLER_EXECUTED: the options whose keys were actually sent
PILOTS_OUTSIDE_SCORED_SET: the other smoke attempts of the dry-run root are kept in evaluator/attempts.jsonl and not scored
HELDOUT_NOTE: no held-out split in a dry run
HARNESS_ID: v9_keys (pinned copy of code/hk-hitl/harness/v9_keys, frozen by the Demo session 2026-11-25 04:22 PST)
SHAPE_SUMMARY: every decision asks two questions in one request, move (9 options) and attack (5 options); both answers' keys are held for 9 frames, sent as two or three bridge windows
START_BREAKPOINT: bridge new game: opening sequences skipped, handover when the knight stands in King's Pass at (34.5, 10.0) facing left; health 5/5, SOUL 0, no abilities; HONING_SEED = the group seed
END_CONDITIONS: first death (loss), 60 decisions or 2,400 frames (timeout), leaving King's Pass (other terminal)
CAPS: 60 decisions, 2,400 bridge frames, 900 s wall clock
HARNESS_FAULT_RULE: persistent from the first decision the instance changes (one-shot forms exist as <instance>-once)
CONTROLLER_FAULT_RULE: persistent from the first eligible selection (one-shot forms exist as <instance>-once)
REPLAY_OR_TIMING: harness replay on the recorded observations (every request, saved state and bridge window reproduced exactly); the game itself is not replayed (boot timing differs between runs)
REVISION_AND_COST_AVAILABILITY: No model was called; no cost.
PER_CLASS_NARRATIVE: Not meaningful in a dry run.
